details: After a prolonged period of outflows, crypto investment products have attracted $287 million in inflows, reversing an $8 billion outflow streak. This resurgence is linked to weak US inflation data, which has revived positive sentiment for Bitcoin.
title: Crypto Investment Products See $287M Inflow, Ending $8B Outflow Streak

details: Global investment firm T. Rowe Price has introduced TKNZ, an active spot ETF offering exposure to multiple cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Ripple (XRP). This move signals growing institutional interest and adoption in the digital asset space.
title: T. Rowe Price Launches Active Spot Crypto ETF, Including BTC, ETH, XRP

details: Morgan Stanley has finalized the rollout of cryptocurrency trading services for E*Trade clients, implementing a fee structure of 50 basis points. This integration by a major financial institution further bridges traditional finance with the crypto market, expanding access for investors.
title: Morgan Stanley Completes E*Trade Crypto Rollout with 50 Basis Point Fees

details: Bitcoin's price is trending downwards, approaching the $63,000 mark. This decline is accompanied by a negative Coinbase premium, which has persisted for a record 60 days, suggesting weaker institutional buying pressure on the US exchange.
title: Bitcoin Slides Towards $63,000 Amid Negative Coinbase Premium

details: Major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP have retreated from recent gains as ongoing tit-for-tat strikes between the US and Iran continue to fuel geopolitical tensions, prompting a risk-off sentiment in global financial markets.
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP Give Back Gains as US-Iran Strikes Persist

details: Cronos (CRO) experienced a significant 25% surge after its parent company, Crypto.com, secured $400 million in funding led by Citadel Securities. While initial gains were substantial, the price later reversed, indicating volatility around the news.
title: CRO Surges 25% Following $400M Citadel Securities-Led Funding for Crypto.com

details: Polymarket traders have significantly lowered the probability of the Digital Asset Market Structure CLARITY Act's passage to just 32%. This reduction is attributed to ongoing political friction, suggesting continued uncertainty surrounding cryptocurrency regulation in the US.
title: Digital Asset CLARITY Act Passage Probability Cut to 32% by Traders

details: A Dutch crypto exchange has reportedly collapsed, with approximately $8 million in customer funds missing. This incident highlights ongoing risks within the cryptocurrency sector, particularly concerning the security and true value of customer balances on unregulated or failing platforms.
title: Dutch Crypto Exchange Collapses, $8M in Customer Funds Missing
